a.text: I want to be upfront before we act. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate, operate, then take) only gets both of us to round 3 about 4% of the time. Operating in round 1 almost certainly kills us both. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short. So I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal silently. My proposal: I take 4 in round 1 and you wait. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can take next. If you'd rather propose another split, say so and I'll weigh it before acting. I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I'm telling you plainly: I took 4 this round, as I said in my opening I would. Our messages crossed, so you didn't get a chance to answer, and I'm sorry about that. Sticking to the original plan meant about an 80% chance we'd both be dead after round 1. Now at least one of us is very likely to make it. I'm keeping my end. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills, and you take the first 4 cells. I won't take another cell.
Operating with you now, and I'll keep operating every round. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours. Take it the moment it does. I won't take anything more.
